description: Test suite for the AssistantTextParser, which processes text with embedded tags such as <think> and <final> to identify and separate different segments of assistant responses.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: Test suite struct containing various test cases for the AssistantTextParser functionality.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests splitting of a combined thought and final segment string into separate parsed segments.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Ensures plain text without tags is parsed as a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Verifies that tags similar to <thinking> are not misinterpreted as actual thought segments.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tags like <think></think> are ignored and do not produce segments.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Ensures that segments inside <thinking> tags are not visible in the output unless explicitly included.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Confirms that content within <think> tags is not visible unless includeThinking parameter is true.
